transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what finally brought me in today is... I feel like the part of me that used to reach out to people, or take pleasure in things, has just gone very quiet. I used to really enjoy my work, doing yoga, going to galleries, even just journaling. But lately, I'm mostly just moving through my obligations. I'm just doing what I have to do every day, and that's about it.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or pleasure in activities like work, yoga, galleries, or journaling since this started?

Yes, exactly. Like I was just saying, that's really the main reason I made this appointment. The pleasure I used to get from all of those things is just... gone. It's all gone very quiet. I don't reach for them anymore, I just do the bare minimum of my obligations.
Do you feel sad or down most of the time now, even when you're not thinking about the things you've lost interest in?

No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. It's not a heavy, crying kind of feeling. It's really just... flat. Like I said, the enjoyment is gone, but it's not replaced by sadness. I just feel kind of empty or blank most of the time, not down.
Have you noticed that you feel fatigued or have a lack of energy most days, even when you haven’t been doing anything physically or mentally taxing?

No, not really. I mean, I have enough energy to get through my day and do what I need to do for work. I don't feel physically tired or exhausted... I just don't have the drive to do anything extra. So it's not a lack of energy, just a lack of interest, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

No, my appetite has been pretty normal. I'm eating about the same amount I usually do, and my weight hasn't really fluctuated. I just eat because it's time to eat, not because I'm particularly excited about the food, but there haven't been any real changes there.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or thinking clearly lately, even when you're trying to focus?

No, I haven't really noticed any problems with my concentration. I can still focus on my work and get things done. It's not that my mind feels foggy or anything like that... I can think clearly enough when I need to. It's just more about not wanting to do things, rather than not being able to focus on them.
Have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, since this started?

No, I wouldn't say I feel depressed or hopeless. I don't feel sad... or down like that. It's really just this sort of emptiness, you know? I don't feel much of anything at all. But it's not a sad feeling, just... blank.
Have you noticed any trouble making decisions, even about small things, or has your thinking felt slowed down lately?

No, I haven't really had any trouble making decisions. I can still decide what to do or what to eat without much of an issue. And my thinking doesn't feel slowed down, either. Like I said before, I can think clearly enough... it's just the motivation that's missing, not the ability to think or decide.
